description: Returns the shared Connect error taxonomy: each error category with its HTTP status, code, response body shape, when the SDKs raise it, whether retrying helps, the language-idiomatic exception type and its extra fields (accounts, retry-after, reason, ...), plus the rules that apply to every error (when the SDKs refresh the token). Optionally filter the per-language columns to one language.

language.description: Filter the per-language columns to one language.

name: getConnectErrorTaxonomy
title: Get Connect Error Taxonomy
